verdict.summary: The bounded status delta is sound as scoped. It enumerates MSB-first changed slots, fails closed for non-newer snapshots, coverage changes, and limit overflow, and keeps freshness as a separate load-bearing precondition. The exhaustive differential test checks the key safety implication across every one-byte snapshot pair and relevant freshness states, while the real-gate test confirms the selected revoked slot is denied. Public exports and access-control documentation are updated, and the limitations around staleness, per-list scope, re-materialisation, and absent in-reasoner retraction are stated honestly.
